spatial_units: Gaussian length 1, Fourier exp(-2 pi i k.x), Lebesgue dx and dk
colour: SU(2) block, f^3_12=+1, f^2_13=-1; coupling external
convention: positive electric and magnetic squares with factor 1/2
states: one outer excitation; inner He_0^3 to He_1(X)He_1(Y)He_1(Z), iid N(0,1)
scope: unreduced Weyl-gauge packet form; no physical spectral or mass witness
soft_control: i(-k_2,k_1,0) exp(-pi |k|^2/width^2), one colour, curl energy/norm^2 = 5*pi*width^2/2

packet_action.formula: sum_i (P_i^2 / metric_i + curl_i Q_i^2)/2 + g entry XYZ + g^2 X^2 (wall_12 Y^2 + wall_13 Z^2)/2
